title: zod core: bigint format check

spec.text: z.int64() / z.uint64() are bigint format checks: reject values outside the format's range, and record the format and range in the schema's bag so introspection (minValue / maxValue getters, toJSONSchema) reports the schema's effective constraints. Format checks compose with .min() / .max() / .check() like any other check.

context: Excerpt of packages/zod/src/v4/core/checks.ts (two checks shown; $ZodCheckGreaterThan is what .min()/.gte()/.positive() create). Every check pushes an onattach hook; when a check is added to a schema, its hooks run in the order the checks were chained and write into the schema's shared inst._zod.bag. The bigint schema's minValue / maxValue getters read bag.minimum / bag.maximum directly, and toJSONSchema reads the same bag. util.BIGINT_FORMAT_RANGES maps int64/uint64 to [min, max] bigint tuples.

source.notes: Verbatim excerpts ($ZodCheckGreaterThan, $ZodCheckBigIntFormat) of checks.ts at parent commit 5489a53; key from fix commit 7a00236 (#6553, fixes #6550), which also fixed the same pattern in $ZodCheckNumberFormat (not shown).
